definition: the thick muscle at the back of your lower leg
description: A floodlit five-a-side pitch at night. A player in a pale blue kit runs onto the ball, then suddenly pulls up and drops onto the grass, rolling onto his side and grabbing the back of his lower leg with both hands, his face screwed up. A man in a grey training vest runs on, kneels beside him, takes hold of his ankle and lower leg and pushes the foot back to stretch the muscle out while the player grimaces and clenches his fist. Team-mates stand watching in the background.

en.question: What is the kneeling man doing?

de.answer: Er dehnt die Wade des Spielers.
de.question: Was macht der kniende Mann?

es.answer: Le está estirando la pantorrilla al jugador.
es.question: ¿Qué está haciendo el hombre arrodillado?

fr.answer: Il étire le mollet du joueur.
fr.question: Que fait l'homme agenouillé ?
